newsitem.title: USA: Amarillo feeder cattle prices mixed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Amarillo feeder cattle prices mixed - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers under 700 lbs steady to $1.00 per cwt higher, over 700 lbs weak to $1.00 lower, compared to last week, USDA said.

Bulk supply Medium and Large 1-2 350-800 lb feeder steers and 350-700 lbs feeder heifers. Large showing of bred cows and cow-calf pairs on offer. Trade active and demand good. Feeder steers and heifers under 600 lbs 44 percent, over 600 lbs 48 percent with cows and bulls around 8 percent of total supply. Receipts - 2,655 Week Ago - 1,855 Year Ago - 2,269

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-650 lbs 83.50- 86.25; 700-800 lbs 80.00-82.75; 800-900 lbs 77.70-79.30; load 925 lbs fleshy 70.40. Medium and Large 1-2 - 600-700 lbs 78.75-83.25; load 779 lbs 78.00; part load 834 lbs 74.00; lot 926 lbs 69.25.
Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 - 600-700 lbs 78.25-80.00, pkg 625 lbs 81.00; pkg 715 lbs 75.50. Medium and Large 1-2 - 600-700 lbs 72.00-78.75; 775-840 lbs 69.00- 73.50.
